cuz-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：库斯科机场的跑道位于安第斯山谷中，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧，周围是城市与山坡。
cuz-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Cusco's runway sits in an Andean valley, with the terminal and apron alongside it and city and hillsides around.

cuz-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 檐口标着机场名称的航站楼前，出租车与私家车在落客区排成一列。
cuz-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Cars and taxis queue along the drop-off lane outside a terminal whose name is spelled out across the canopy, mountains visible to the left.

cuz-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 航拍显示一条跑道嵌在密集的红瓦城区中，四周是层层叠叠的房屋与环抱的山峦。
cuz-chatgpt-02.webp.en: An aerial shows a single runway set down amid a dense sprawl of red-roofed houses, with terraced hills ringing the city.

cuz-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架涂有 LAN 标志的客机靠上航站楼，地勤推着行李车在机身旁忙碌，背后是一道青灰色山脊。
cuz-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A jet in LAN colours is pulled up at the terminal, ground crew handling baggage carts beside it under a dark green mountain ridge.

cuz-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 灰云压顶，旅客在航站楼前走动，檐口写着机场全名，塔台标着 CORPAC，黄色栏杆沿花坛延伸。
cuz-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Under heavy grey cloud, travellers walk in front of the terminal, its name along the canopy and a CORPAC sign on the tower above yellow railings.

cuz-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 从机舱窗口越过机翼望去，滑行道通向跑道，干黄的草地外是山坡上的城区与远处的群山。
cuz-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Looking out over the wing, a taxiway runs toward the runway past dry yellow grass, with city slopes and distant mountains beyond.

cuz-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 机上写着 LATAM 的客机停在机坪上，前方是红砖楼房与黄色「07」牌子，积云堆在山顶上空。
cuz-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A LATAM jet sits on the apron before a row of brick buildings, a yellow '07' marker on the wall and towering cumulus above the hills.

cuz-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 机坪上一架客机正滑行经过两个停靠廊桥的 LAN 机位，背后山坡上密密麻麻都是红砖房屋。
cuz-chatgpt-07.webp.en: One aircraft taxis across the apron past two LAN jets parked at the gates, with brick houses packed densely up the green hillside behind.
